plugin.name: x11-windows
plugin._long: X11 windows where and as their programs ask: games on the screen they ask for and borderless full screen made full screen.

option.name: games
option._short: Games get the screen they ask for
option._long: A full-screen X11 window goes to the screen it asked for rather than the focused one, and a window without a frame that asks to cover a whole screen (a game's "borderless full screen") is made full screen there instead of being fitted between the menu bar and the dock.
